verdict: Rigetti's revenue nearly tripled to $5.1M, but a $29.6M non-cash warrant charge on top of $30M of running costs produced a $52.6M net loss.

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP diluted)
kpis.note: Non-GAAP loss was -$0.05 per share, leaving out the warrant charge and stock pay

kpis.label: Cash & investments
kpis.note: Cash, cash equivalents and available-for-sale investments at June 30; no debt

kpis.label: Warrant charge
kpis.note: Non-cash charge from revaluing warrant liabilities as the share price moved

segments.name: United States
segments.note: Revenue from US customers — mostly government and research contracts for quantum systems and cloud access. Up 327% YoY.

segments.name: Asia and other
segments.note: Revenue from Asia and everywhere else outside the US and Europe. Up from just $0.06M a year ago.

segments.name: Europe
segments.note: Revenue from European customers. Down 77% YoY — contract timing, not a lost business line.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Building quantum processors and the software stack — by far the biggest cost, up 53% YoY.

opex.name: Selling, general & administrative
opex.note: Selling plus the back office: finance, legal and admin. Up 37% YoY.

otherDetail: Other expense was $24.5M, net: a $29.6M non-cash charge from the change in fair value of derivative warrant liabilities (warrants are contracts whose paper value swings with Rigetti's share price), partly offset by $5.1M of interest income on its cash and investments.
follow100Note: Rigetti is an early-stage company: it spent about $11 for every $1 it took in this quarter, so the $100 view is scaled up accordingly — the loss was covered by cash raised earlier.

takeaways.title: Revenue nearly tripled — off a tiny base
takeaways.text: Revenue rose to $5.1M from $1.8M a year ago, driven by US customers ($4.1M, up 327%). One customer alone was 64% of the quarter's revenue, so single contracts swing the numbers hard. Rigetti also signed an expanded collaboration with HPE and the Pittsburgh Supercomputing Center, and a letter of intent for up to $100M of potential US Department of Commerce funding.

takeaways.title: Running costs are 6x revenue
takeaways.text: Operating costs were $30.3M against $5.1M of revenue: $20.7M of research and development and $9.5M of selling, general and administrative costs. The operating loss was $28.1M. Leaving out stock pay and the warrant charge, the company's own non-GAAP net loss was $16.0M.

takeaways.title: A paper charge doubled the loss
takeaways.text: The GAAP net loss was $52.6M, of which $29.6M was a non-cash charge from revaluing warrant liabilities — no money left the company; the liability's paper value rose with the share price. Rigetti ended the quarter with $541M of cash and investments and no debt, which is what funds losses at this scale.

oneTimers: The $29.6M change in fair value of derivative warrant liabilities is a non-cash mark-to-market charge (revaluing warrants at the current share price). It was a $24.1M gain in the first half as a whole, so it swings sign quarter to quarter.
footerNote: Rigetti reports in thousands; figures here are exact to the thousand, shown in $M. Rigetti had not reported Q3 2026 as of November 7, 2026, so Q2 is its latest quarter.
